mapper.sql: FROM ( SELECT proid, MAX(pname) AS pname, SUM(num) AS return_quantity, MAX(retdate) AS last_return_date FROM cusretire WHERE retdate BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND num > 0 GROUP BY proid ) r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT proid, SUM(num) AS sale_quantity FROM sale WHERE saledate BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND num > 0 GROUP BY proid ) s ON s.proid = r.proid
mapper.select:
SELECT r.proid, COALESCE(p.pname, r.pname) AS pname, COALESCE(s.sale_quantity, 0) AS sale_quantity, r.return_quantity, ROUND(r.return_quantity * 100.0 / NULLIF(s.sale_quantity, 0), 2) AS return_rate, r.last_return_date, (r.return_quantity >= #{quantityThreshold}) AS quantity_warning, (COALESCE(s.sale_quantity, 0) > 0 AND r.return_quantity * 100 >= s.sale_quantity * #{rateThreshold}) AS rate_warning
LEFT JOIN product p ON p.proid = r.proid
ORDER BY (quantity_warning + rate_warning) DESC, r.return_quantity DESC, r.proid ASC
